title: Wood in stonecutter
description: Allows you to craft wooden items in a stonecutter
body:
# Wood in Stonecutter

wood in stonecutter is a datapack that allows you to craft wooden items in a stonecutter

> **NOTE**: On 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, and 1.21.8 when you add the datapack during world creation the game may tell you that the datapack whas made for an older version of Minecraft. This datapack is compatible with the newer versions so you can ignore this warning.

### with planks you can craft:

![example of things you can get from putting planks in a stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FLMtkveB/images/34bfca70755594b328c158aecee55e022ee5b1ac.png)

- 1 button
- 1 door
- 1 fence
- 1 fence gate
- 1 pressure plate
- 1 sign
- 2 slabs
- 1 stairs
- 1 trapdoor
- 3 sticks

### with logs you can craft:

![example of things you can get from putting logs in a stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FLMtkveB/images/ac598a6e9d4291e3d7c1426698405c9e99b773a5.png)

- 4 planks
- 1 boat - warped & crimson don't have boats
- 1 stripped log
- 1 wood block* - bamboo doesn't have wood blocks*

### with stripped logs you can craft:

![example of things you can get by puttin stripped logs in a stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb5f1e9b6154b024521cfb9ad5b755fc54824d1a.png)

- 4 planks
- 1 boat - warped & crimson don't have boats
- 1 stripped wood block* - bamboo doesnt have stripped wood blocks*
- 1 shelf

### with wood blocks* you can craft:

![example of things you can craft by putting wood blocks in a stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FLMtkveB/images/9a8b502a626b729b75ac5c0a360d62d878f28910.png)

- 1 stripped wood block*

_**\* with "wood blocks" I mean the ones with bark on all six sides**_
